limitations: NO historical period market prices — accuracy metrics only; NO profitability/edge claim
GR shock scale from empirical CV is UNFITTED (not holdout-calibrated)
No injury/roster/weather as-of features — team empirical quarter vectors only
Scenario drivers not pre-written historically — any narrative would be reconstruction, not pre-kick
Training pool = all as-of games; metrics are genuine walk-forward test per kickoff week — do not conflate with in-sample fit
Opponent strength not modeled beyond opponent's own as-of empirical distribution
